lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr12Cr6C6 (reduced formula Sr2CrC) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies octahedral Cr centers coordinated by six C neighbors, while C centers show two distinct environments with two Cr neighbors, and Sr centers display 8- and 9-neighbor environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and face-sharing between Cr octahedra and 9-vertex Sr polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among 8-vertex Sr polyhedra.
